root.name: ウェイスト・マネジメント

rows.ja: 埋立地ガス・用地の提携先
競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: 2024年11月に1株62ドルの現金で全株を取得(現在のヘルスケア・ソリューション事業)
relations.text_en: Acquired all shares for $62 per share in cash in November 2024; now its Healthcare Solutions business

source.label: Waste Management 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On November 4, 2024, we completed our acquisition of all outstanding shares of Stericycle for $62.00 per share in cash, pursuant to an Agreement and Plan of Merger dated June 3, 2024.

companies.name: モンタウク・リニューアブルズ

relations.text: Montaukの売上の約37%は、Waste Managementが運営する埋立地でのガス事業から
relations.text_en: About 37% of Montauk's revenue comes from projects at landfills operated by Waste Management

source.label: Montauk Renewables 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our projects located on Waste Management operated landfills represented 36.8%, 38.5% and 37.3% of our revenue in 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively.

companies.name: オパール・フューエルズ

relations.text: OPAL FuelsがWaste Managementのカリフォルニア子会社と用地の賃貸借契約を結ぶ
relations.text_en: OPAL Fuels has a lease agreement with Waste Management of California

source.label: OPAL Fuels 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Lease Agreement, dated August 28, 2023 with Waste Management of California, Inc.

companies.name: ウェイスト・コネクションズ

relations.text: Waste Connectionsが10-Kで、競合する上場の廃棄物大手としてWaste Managementを挙げる
relations.text_en: Waste Connections names Waste Management among the publicly held solid waste companies it competes with

source.label: Waste Connections 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our competition includes: three publicly-held solid waste companies-Waste Management, Inc., Republic Services, Inc. and GFL Environmental, Inc.

companies.name: クリーン・ハーバーズ

relations.text: Clean Harborsが10-Kで、2025年に競合した全国規模の企業の一社としてWaste Managementを挙げる
relations.text_en: Clean Harbors names Waste Management among the national firms it competed with in 2025

source.label: Clean Harbors 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Veolia North America, Enviri Corporation, Republic Services, Waste Management, GFL Environmental and Crystal Clean were the principal national firms with which we competed in 2025.

companies.name: カセラ・ウェイスト・システムズ

relations.text: Casellaが10-Kで、都市部で競合する全国規模の廃棄物大手としてWaste Managementを挙げる
relations.text_en: Casella names Waste Management among the national solid waste companies it competes with in larger markets

source.label: Casella Waste Systems 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: we typically compete against one or more of the large national solid waste companies, including Waste Management, Inc., Republic Services, Inc. and Waste Connections, Inc.

companies.name: クエスト・リソース
companies.sub: 廃棄物・リサイクル管理

relations.text: Quest Resourceが10-Kの競合の項で、業界を支配する大手としてWaste Managementを挙げる
relations.text_en: Quest Resource names Waste Management in its competition section as one of the large landfill companies dominating the industry

source.label: Quest Resource 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The recycling and waste disposal industry as a whole is dominated by large multi-billion-dollar landfill companies, such as Waste Management and Republic Services.

relations.text: PureBaseが10-Kで、フライアッシュの潜在的な競合としてWaste Managementを挙げる
relations.text_en: PureBase names Waste Management among potential competitors in fly ash

source.label: PureBase 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Other potential competitors include fly ash distributors, notably Boral Industries, Inc. and Waste Management, Inc.
